room-missing.meaning: a .world entry names a room file that can't be loaded

room-id-dup.meaning: two rooms of the world have one id (the file name without .tmj)

tileset-missing.meaning: a room's tileset can't be loaded, so its collision is unknown

start-count.meaning: the world has no start object, or more than one

start-solid.meaning: the start's cell is solid, or outside its room

door-target.meaning: a door has no target, or its target room can't be loaded

door-entry.meaning: a door has no entry, or its target room has no door of that name

door-pair.meaning: a door's partner doesn't lead back to it

door-name-dup.meaning: two doors in one room have one name

door-arrival.meaning: no walkable cell beside a door, so arriving there lands in a solid

door-unreachable.meaning: a door can't be touched from anywhere the start reaches

edge-one-side.meaning: a stretch of shared edge is walkable on one side and solid on the other

room-unreachable.meaning: no walkable cell of a room can be reached from the start
